benches.name: exact_tiled
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_svcio_od_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_svcio_od_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { command -v verilator >/dev/null && XDEF=+define+SVCIO_TILED bash rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/svc/run_svc_io_bench.sh {RUN}/bench && test $(grep -c 'run_g_.*RESULT PASS' {RUN}/bench/summary.txt) -eq 3
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 387a4d2ac snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_svcio_od_m5/src]

benches.name: neg_noatom
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_svcio_od_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_svcio_od_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { grep 'run_m1' {RUN}/bench/summary.txt; grep -q 'run_m1.log.*RESULT FAIL' {RUN}/bench/summary.txt && { echo 'SVCIO_NEG FAIL'; exit 1; }; exit 0
